title: Smoky Butter Bean Dip
ingredients: 400g can butter beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Put all ingredients in a food processor; whizz until smooth.
notes: Great with carrot and pepper sticks or spread on Wholemeal Flatbreads. The butter bean base works with many flavours — try adding roasted peppers or fresh chilli. Easy to scale up for a crowd.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
